text: Being here, I am enveloped by an atmosphere of curiosity and innovation. The glass-walled room ahead feels both transparent and mysterious, hinting at collaboration and the pursuit of knowledge. The vibrant, graphic exposition about research and development draws my attention, merging technology with the art of discovery. I feel an odd sense of anticipation, as though I'm on the threshold of new ideas and creative possibilities, both introspective and outward-looking—a participant in humanity's unfolding exploration.
